description: This file declares the QConvoneDNN class with static methods for performing various pointwise quantized convolution operations, including binary and tensor-based variants, in the PyTorch ATen library's CPU backend.

classes.name: QConvoneDNN
classes.description: A class providing static methods for executing quantized pointwise convolution operations on CPU.

methods.name: run_pointwise
methods.description: Performs a quantized pointwise convolution on tensors, with options for scalar parameters.

methods.name: run_pointwise_tensor
methods.description: Performs a quantized pointwise convolution where scale and zero point are provided as tensors.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary quantized pointwise convolution operation, with additional accum and binary-specific parameters.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary_tensor
methods.description: Performs a binary quantized pointwise convolution where scales and zero points are tensors.
